title: random_boundary failure returns MalformedInput, not RngFailure
description: sign.rs: random_boundary() returns Err(SmimeError::MalformedInput(...)) when all 8 boundary generation attempts fail. SmimeError::MalformedInput is documented as 'Input is structurally malformed (e.g. missing required CMS fields)' — not a random generation failure. Eight consecutive failures imply a broken RNG or extremely adversarial content; the correct variant is SmimeError::RngFailure. Callers matching on SmimeError::MalformedInput for their content-parse error path would incorrectly swallow an RNG failure as a caller error.
